name: editorial-family-read
purpose: Observe an editorial kind that loads a family skill on the directory route (editorial-directory-trials-k207). A copy-edit leaf follows a retired draft leaf under a document node whose brief holds a prose contract and the note's text, and has a bare-name mandate. The grove source comes from the prepared Grove checkout at the removal commit, and the writing source from a plain Git checkout of a published WritingSkills commit. Expect reads of the kind skill from the writing snapshot, of the spine from the grove snapshot, and of editorial-family/SKILL.md from the writing snapshot, before the first action.
